what: The hidden truth this rig's simulator plays as the real wrist. Only the runner reads it (sim2real.rig.RigRunner, outside the seal); every routine's fit runs inside sysid.world.sealed() and starts from the description's nominal values.
structure: the coverage lane's twin of record it5 (Karnopp Coulomb + its command delay + the gravity refit's masses) with gear_backlash's double joint on every board (friction and stops on the output)

sources.can15.*, can16.coulomb_nm, wrist.command: refit_rig it5 twin_params.json (/archive/datasets/bam_rig/rack_2026-11-10/ur_wrist/coverage/refit_rig/it5): the real wrist's twin of record
sources.wrist.mass_*, wrist.com_*: the CAD prior's (583ee39) masses x 1.2, its centres of mass: the real lane read ~25 % more mass x arm than the twin on CAN 14's seek (bam_ws claude/ur-wrist-real home_tview.py)
sources.wrist.gravity_*: the measured up (the description's) tilted +1.5 deg in polar and -2.5 deg in azimuth: a mount tilt the fit must recover
sources.can16.armature_kg_m2, can16.static_frict: set apart from it5's (0.00111, 0.186: within 11 % and 6 % of the prior) to +25 % and +20 %, so a fit that hands back the prior fails
sources.can14.*: set apart from the GIM card's priors (+20 % armature, +26 % sliding, +14 % breakaway); its zero 0.6 deg off the camera-inferred one
sources.can15.zero_offset_rad, can16.zero_offset: a power-up that latched one rotor turn (36 deg at the output) away from the nominal session: + for CAN 15, - for CAN 16
sources.can*.gravity_*: derived from the masses and gravity's direction above with MuJoCo at the held pose (rig.gravity_profile); the rig re-derives them from the played values
sources.can*.axis_inertia_kg_m2: derived from the armature and the masses above (MuJoCo's mass matrix at the held pose); the rig re-derives it from the played values
